description: 北九州市 市営バス停留所一覧(北九州市内) [bus and public transit] is a dataset listed in BODIK Open Data Catalogue Service (data.bodik.jp), Japanese local governments, an open data portal, published or maintained by 北九州市. 北九州市内の市営バス停留所の一覧です。 緯度経度について：世界測地系（JGD2000)による緯度・経度（10進数）です。. Coverage: 北九州市. The portal files it under the publisher 北九州市. Its tags are 経度, 緯度. It offers 2 resource(s) in csv. The portal shows 2025-03-28 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Japanese; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Creative Commons Attribution. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support public transport network, service and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-jp-bodik-portal.
